description: This file defines the 'Review' class within the Goteo project's Model layer, responsible for handling user reviews, including CRUD operations, validation, comments, scoring, and permission checks.

classes.name: Review
classes.description: Represents and manages user reviews in the system, including retrieval, validation, creation, deletion, status updates, comments, scoring, and permission checks.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves all review identifiers for a specific user.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates if the review has necessary fields (id, user) before saving.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Inserts or updates a review record in the database.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a review assignment from a user.

methods.name: unready
methods.description: Reopens a review that was marked as completed.

methods.name: checkers
methods.description: Returns a list of users associated with a particular review.

methods.name: is_legal
methods.description: Checks if a user is legally permitted to perform actions on a review.

methods.name: setComment
methods.description: Sets a comment for a specific section and field within a review.

methods.name: setScore
methods.description: Sets or deletes a score for a specific criterion within a review.

methods.name: recount
methods.description: Calculates and updates the total score for a review.

methods.name: is_assigned
methods.description: Checks if a user is assigned to review a specific project.
